description: This file defines a Perl module for a script that allows setting a new password for a user in the Coocook application. It includes methods for interacting with the user via terminal input, updating the database, and handling password confirmation.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Passwd
classes.description: A Perl class implementing a script to change user passwords within the Coocook system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the password change process, including user input, validation, and database update.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line of input from the terminal with optional prompt, handling no-echo mode for password input.
